q1_issues.issue: the restrictive modifier "other" in "other manners and customs" is dropped, so the parse claims contact with manners and customs at large (same for statement 3)
"with" is encoded twice — once inside the action symbol come_into_contact_with and again as the (With ...) head carrying that preposition's object
come_into_contact_with gets no decomposition atom at all while study_overseas gets a genus, so the two compound action symbols in one parse are decomposed inconsistently

q2_gaps: a means adjunct ("by V-ing") on a kind-level modal property — the instruction set offers only ConditionalProperty's condition slot, specified for states / environments, and nothing for means or instrument

a prepositional or adverbial compound action inside a reified (can ...) — Compound concepts specifies only genus + (Patient <compound> <object>), so a prepositional object ("come into contact with X") and an adverbial modifier ("study overseas") have no stated encoding
notes: Routing the capability generic onto ConditionalProperty is licensed (the property slot may hold a reified capability term, as in the "Contractors must show a badge at entry" example), and (With ...) is licensed as a prepositional-verb oblique head, but attaching that oblique to an action term rather than an event witness is an extension of the rule.
